releaseNotes:
Bike Sync 2.4.18

- Adds a persistent leaderboard review queue with the full route, sensor, wind, terrain, group-ride, rider-history, and ambiguity rubric.
- Runs a permission-free Monday-morning review of saved cases and shows an alert only when an effort still needs inspection.
- Prepares neutral, evidence-specific Strava report text without submitting or flagging anything automatically.
- Adds wearable-neutral recovery setup for Polar, WHOOP, Garmin, Oura, Suunto, COROS, and other Intervals.icu-supported sources; missing metrics remain hidden and neutral.
- Adds a stable public download-and-support page in Help and keeps the installed product as one bicycle-icon Bike Sync app.
